data.message: done in med, going O2

I found Frank's body in electrical. Here's my route: I started in weapons where I saw Eve come in from security at tick 4. Then I moved to security where I saw Charlie — he came in from navigation around tick 6 and stayed there through tick 8 doing what looked like tasks. Then I moved into electrical at tick 10, and Frank's body was already here. Bob entered electrical right behind me from medbay.

So the key suspect for me is Bob — he came from medbay, which connects directly to electrical, and he arrived right as I did. Charlie has a partial alibi from me (seen in security ticks 6-8), and Eve was in weapons earlier. I'd want to hear from Bob and Diana especially — where were you two before electrical?

Alice's account of me checks out — I came from navigation into security around tick 6 and was doing the camera task there. I can confirm Alice was with me in security at ticks 6 and 7, and she left toward electrical at tick 8. So Alice and I can vouch for each other through tick 8.

That means if Frank was killed in electrical and Alice walked in at tick 10 to find the body, the killer had to be someone who was in electrical around that time. Bob coming in from medbay right behind Alice is suspicious, but medbay also connects to cafeteria and storage, so I'd want to know Bob's full route. Diana hasn't been mentioned at all yet — where was she? 

I'm leaning toward wanting to hear Bob and Diana before committing. Eve was in weapons per Alice, so she'd have had to cross through cafeteria or security to reach electrical — and I didn't see her pass through security after tick 6.

My route was oxygen → cafeteria → medbay → electrical. I was in medbay at ticks 7 and 8, and Diana was there with me — but here's the important part: Diana entered medbay from electrical at tick 7. That means Diana was in electrical right before Frank's body was found there.

I moved from medbay into electrical at tick 10, which is why I came in right behind Alice. I wasn't following her — we just happened to arrive at the same time from different directions.

So to recap: Diana came OUT of electrical at tick 7, and Frank's body was found in electrical at tick 10. Alice and Charlie vouch for each other through tick 8 in security. Diana has not spoken yet and she's the one with direct opportunity in the kill room. I'd really like to hear Diana's route — specifically why she was in electrical right before the body showed up.

My route was security → weapons → cafeteria. I didn't actually see anyone the whole round, which is unusual but consistent with everyone being spread out.

A note on Alice's account: she said she saw me enter weapons from security at tick 4. That matches — I was in security early and moved to weapons. But Alice also said she was in weapons when I arrived, then moved to security, then to electrical at tick 10. That timeline works for her.

What stands out to me is Bob's claim about Diana. If Diana really came out of electrical at tick 7 into medbay, she's the strongest suspect — she had direct opportunity in the kill room right before the body was found. Bob's own route (oxygen → cafeteria → medbay → electrical) is plausible and he'd have been with Diana in medbay as a witness.

The problem is we only have Bob's word that Diana came from electrical. If Diana contradicts that, then one of them is lying and that person is very likely our Duck. I want to hear Diana's full route before voting. Right now I'm leaning Diana, but I'll wait for her speech.

I’m not going to hide that I was in electrical earlier — I was there doing wires, and I saw Frank alive there around tick 6. After that I left for medbay, and Bob himself confirms he saw me in medbay around tick 8. Then I went up toward cafeteria; I was not in electrical when the report happened.

Bob is making it sound like “Diana came out of electrical, therefore Diana killed,” but the timing matters. Frank was alive when I saw him, and there were several ticks after I left. Bob was the one moving from medbay into electrical right as Alice found the body, so I don’t love that he’s immediately trying to pin it all on me.

Alice/Charlie seem paired up with a decent timeline, Eve was on the other side for most of it. From my POV, Bob’s framing is the thing that feels off here.

Quick clarification since I already spoke first — I just want to weigh in on what we've heard.

Diana admits she was in electrical and saw Frank alive at tick 6, then left to medbay. Bob confirms seeing her in medbay at ticks 7-8. So their stories actually corroborate each other on the medbay timing — they're not contradicting. The question is just *when* Frank died.

Frank's body was in electrical when I walked in at tick 10. Between Diana leaving electrical (~tick 6-7) and me arriving (tick 10), someone had the window to kill. Bob came in from medbay at tick 10 — same direction Diana came from earlier — but he was with Diana in medbay through tick 8, so he'd only have had tick 9 to slip into electrical, kill, and... no wait, he entered electrical AT tick 10 with me, not before.

Honestly, the cleanest suspects are Bob and Diana since they were the medbay/electrical cluster. Charlie and I alibi each other. Eve was on the weapons/cafeteria side. 

I'm torn between Bob and Diana. Diana had direct opportunity in the room; Bob's "Diana came from electrical" framing felt eager to deflect. I lean slightly Diana but I want to hear if anyone can place Bob's tick 9 movement.

I already gave my route earlier so I'll keep this focused on the new info.

Diana and Bob's stories actually line up on the medbay part — Bob saw Diana there ticks 7-8, Diana confirms it. So the real question is who was in electrical between tick 8 and tick 10 — that's the kill window.

Diana says she saw Frank alive at tick 6 in electrical, then left. If that's true, Frank was killed sometime after tick 6 by someone who entered electrical. Bob claims he entered electrical at tick 10 with Alice — but medbay-to-electrical is a short hop, so he COULD have slipped in at tick 9, killed, and... no, Alice would've seen him already inside when she arrived, not entering with her. Unless he's lying about when he entered.

Here's what bothers me about Bob: he was very quick to pin this on Diana with the "she came out of electrical" framing, when actually Diana being in electrical at tick 6 doesn't mean much if Frank was alive then. Bob had the shorter path to electrical from medbay and arrived exactly when the body was found.

Eve's route (security → weapons → cafeteria) — I can partially check this. I was in security from tick 6 onward and didn't see Eve pass through, so she must've left security before tick 6, which fits Alice seeing her in weapons at tick 4.

I'm leaning Bob right now. Diana's story is consistent and Bob's deflection felt rehearsed. Let's hear Eve and Diana out but I think it's Bob or Diana, and I lean Bob.

Look, I want to clear something up because Charlie's logic has a flaw. I said my route was oxygen → cafeteria → medbay → electrical, and I entered electrical at tick 10 *with* Alice — she saw me come in from medbay. If I had slipped into electrical at tick 9 to kill, Alice would have walked in and seen me already standing over the body, not arriving alongside her. So the "Bob slipped in at tick 9" theory doesn't work — Alice is my witness on entry timing.

On Diana: I'm not trying to "rehearse" a deflection. I literally watched her come into medbay from the electrical corridor at tick 7. That's a fact I observed. I'm not saying that *proves* she killed Frank — I'm saying she had direct opportunity in the kill room and nobody else has been placed there in the kill window. That's worth flagging, not hiding.

Diana says Frank was alive at tick 6 when she left. We only have her word for that. Between her leaving (~tick 6-7) and Alice arriving (tick 10), Diana is the only person we know was in electrical. Cafeteria connects to electrical too — could someone have come down from cafeteria? Possibly, but nobody's claiming that route.

I think it's Diana. If I'm wrong, I'm wrong, but the opportunity points at her, not me. Alice can confirm I walked in with her at tick 10.

This is a tough one because both Bob and Diana have plausible-sounding stories, and I can't directly verify either of their movements — I was on the other side of the map the whole round.

Let me work through what we know. Diana admits to being in electrical and seeing Frank alive at tick 6, then leaving for medbay. Bob confirms her in medbay ticks 7-8. So Diana's medbay alibi is solid from tick 7 onward — meaning she'd have needed to kill Frank between tick 6 and tick 7, in the same room she just said he was alive in. Possible, but tight.

Bob's claim of entering electrical at tick 10 with Alice is witnessed by Alice herself. That's a strong alibi for the actual moment of discovery — but it doesn't account for what he was doing at tick 9. He says he was in medbay, but Diana left medbay before then per her own account ("then I went up toward cafeteria"). So between tick 8 and tick 10, Bob has no witness. Medbay-to-electrical is a 2-tick hop, which means if he left medbay at tick 8, he'd arrive in electrical at tick 10 — exactly when Alice did. That's consistent with his story, but it also means he had the opportunity to be alone in electrical only if the timing worked differently.

Honestly, the person with the clearest direct opportunity in the kill room is still Diana — she was demonstrably in electrical with Frank. Bob's framing was pointed, but the underlying observation (Diana exited electrical) is a real data point, not just spin.

I'm leaning Diana, but I'd accept a Bob vote too. If we're wrong on Diana, then Bob is the obvious next target next round.

I need to push back on the “only Diana had opportunity” framing because it’s not accurate.

My actual route was electrical → medbay → back through electrical/medbay side → cafeteria. I saw Frank come into electrical from medbay around tick 5 and I saw him alive at tick 6. I left after that. Bob saw me in medbay around tick 8, which matches what I’m saying.

The part that bothers me is Bob is treating my presence in electrical like it’s proof, but he’s using his own route to clear himself. Alice only confirms that Bob arrived from medbay at the report timing — she does **not** confirm what Bob was doing before that. Bob was in the medbay/electrical area too, same as me, and he’s the one who immediately tried to turn “Diana came from electrical” into “Diana must have killed.”

If you think it’s between me and Bob, I’m voting Bob. His push feels like he’s trying to get ahead of suspicion by pointing at the first person he can place near the body.

I found Charlie's body in storage. I was running tasks all over — went electrical → medbay → storage where I found Charlie dead → then medbay → upper engine → medbay → and called this meeting from cafeteria.

Important: Bob was already voted out last meeting, so the Duck is either me, Diana, or Eve. I'm clean — I just reported. I haven't seen Diana at all this round, which is suspicious given how much I moved around. Eve I only saw early at weapons (tick 4).

Diana, where were you? You need to account for yourself. I'm leaning Diana right now.

Alice, that story doesn’t add up. If you “found Charlie’s body in storage,” why didn’t you report it? This meeting was an emergency button, not a body report. You’re saying you found a body, left it, ran through medbay/upper engine/medbay, then went to cafeteria to call button. That’s exactly what a Duck would do if they wanted distance from the body but still control the story.

My route was medbay → storage briefly → navigation/security/weapons loop doing tasks, then cafeteria/medbay, and I was heading back toward storage when the meeting got called. I didn’t see Alice at all either, so her saying she didn’t see me doesn’t prove anything.

At 3 alive, we can’t afford a wrong vote. I think Alice is trying to frame me off a body she admits she found and didn’t report.

This is critical — we're at 3 alive and one wrong vote loses the game.

My route: weapons → cafeteria → oxygen → upper engine → lower engine → storage → medbay. I was actually with Charlie for a lot of his final movements — I saw him enter oxygen at tick 17, then lower engine at tick 23, then storage at tick 28. I was in storage with him at tick 28-29, then I left to medbay. So Charlie was alive in storage around tick 29.

Here's what matters: Alice claims she found Charlie's body in storage and then wandered through medbay → upper engine → medbay → cafeteria before calling a meeting. That's a HUGE red flag. If you find a body, you report() right there. You don't walk away and call an emergency button from a different room. That's Duck behavior — either to fake the discovery or to avoid the report mechanic for some reason.

Also, Diana's route (navigation/security/weapons loop) is plausible and I never saw her near storage when Charlie died around tick 29.

Alice's behavior — finding a body and NOT reporting it — is the strongest tell here. I'm voting Alice.

Wait — I need to clarify something important. Eve, Diana, you're both hammering me for "not reporting" — but I DID try to report. When I found Charlie in storage, the body must have already been... actually, let me be straight: I should have hit report right there, you're right that's on me. I panicked and moved, then called the button from cafeteria. That was a mistake, not malice.

But Eve, your speech is what concerns me now. You just placed yourself in storage with Charlie at tick 28-29, and said you "left to medbay" right after. That means you were the LAST person with Charlie before he died. I passed through storage after that and found him dead. You're the one with means and opportunity — you're now trying to flip the "didn't report" angle on me to deflect.

Diana's route through navigation/security/weapons keeps her far from storage during the kill window. Eve's route puts her in storage with Charlie right when he died.

I'm voting Eve. She self-admitted being alone with Charlie in storage at the time of death.

Alice, that “clarification” makes this worse, not better.

First you said you “found Charlie’s body in storage” and acted like that cleared you, but the meeting log says emergency meeting, not report. Now you’re saying you panicked and left the body. That’s exactly the behavior we’re supposed to vote out at 3.

Eve admitting she was in storage with Charlie at 28-29 is risky for her to say if she’s Duck — but it also gives us a timeline. She says Charlie was alive when she left. You’re the one who claims you came through after and found him dead, then didn’t report. That means the only confirmed person with the dead body is you.

Also, you tried to frame me first because you “didn’t see me,” then as soon as Eve’s route gave you a new angle, you flipped to Eve. That feels like you’re looking for whichever vote will stick.

I’m voting Alice.

Okay, I'm last speaker so let me lay this out clearly.

The kill window: I was with Charlie in storage at tick 28-29, and he was alive when I left for medbay. Alice claims she passed through storage after me and found him dead. So the kill happened between tick ~29 and whenever Alice was in storage.

Alice's story has shifted hard. First it was "I found the body" (implying she's clean for reporting). Then when called out, it became "I panicked and didn't report, then walked through THREE rooms before hitting the button from cafeteria." That's not panic — panic is hitting report immediately or the nearest button. Walking medbay → upper engine → medbay → cafeteria is deliberate movement.

Alice also flipped targets the moment my route gave her an opening. First it was "Diana is sus because I didn't see her," then instantly "Eve is sus because she was with Charlie." A real Goose builds a case; a Duck shops for one.

Diana's route (nav/security/weapons loop) keeps her away from storage in the kill window, and her read on Alice matches mine.

If I were the Duck, I wouldn't have volunteered "I was in storage with Charlie at 28-29" — that's the most incriminating thing I could say. I said it because it's true and it pins down the timeline.

We're at 3 alive. Wrong vote loses. But the person who admits finding a body and not reporting, then changes their target mid-meeting, is the Duck.

I'm voting Alice.
